scope: Two manuscript family; pinned indexed source/Lean comparator reconnaissance only. Absence from indexed paths does not establish no theorem under another Lean name.

manuscripts.title: Hilbert's tenth problem over the rational numbers
manuscripts.main_claim: No algorithm determines whether arbitrary integer-coefficient polynomial in variable input dimension has a rational zero.

manuscripts.title: A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion
manuscripts.main_claim: For rational elliptic curves with nonzero rational 2-torsion, 2-power Selmer corank 0 or 1 forces analytic and Mordell-Weil ranks equal to the corank and finiteness of Sha; arbitrary reduction at 2 allowed.
